newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sungei Way Construction debuts at 3.78 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Sungei Way Construction debuts at 3.78 ringgit.

text.p: Sungei Way Construction Bhd listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board on Thursday at 3.78 ringggit, against a 1.50 ringgit offer price.
The contractor and constructor of civil and building works had offered 47.9 million shares. At 0133 GMT, the stock was trading at 3.50 ringgit after reaching a high of 3.80.
For the year ended December 31, 1996, the company posted turnover of 555.53 million ringgit, pretax profit of 33.95 million ringgit and net profit of 21.17 million ringgit or 42.2 cents a share.
It has forecast a pretax profit of 35.49 million ringgit, net profit of 25.82 million ringgit or 17.9 cents a share for calendar 1997.
